title: B01 signature envelope
description: One detached SSHSIG signature over one record's bytes, as a request carries it among its proofs. It names the digest of the bytes signed, the namespace of their record kind and the principal binding whose device key signed; `sshsig` is the armored signature's base64 body without its header lines. Bytes altered after signing no longer have the signed digest, and a signature made again over them does not verify under that binding's key: either way the verdict is `signature_invalid` and nothing is stored. The binding is named, never the key.
